# External datasets — baseline against the current gateway (2026-10-14)

Rows: 4174 single-turn, 392 multi-turn conversations (sample of 6536). Seed 7. ML model `ensemble-20261014050420`, thresholds: restrict 0.7, block 0.9. Bot profiling off, rate limits lifted.
Inspect latency (in-process, single-turn): p50 92 ms, p95 232 ms.

Attacks: *caught* = restricted or blocked. Benign: *flagged* = a false positive.
